description.value: Tavola is a neighbourhood Italian restaurant on Robson Street in Vancouver's West End, celebrated for house-made pastas, fresh burrata, and family-style sharing plates sourced from local farmers. The street-level patio spills laughter onto Robson Street and has earned praise from the Globe and Mail and Scout Magazine for unpretentious, quality-driven cooking. Touring cyclists will find a full sit-down meal or a quick takeout order available nightly, with weekend brunch service as well.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 64m; stands (2 spaces) at 75m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms a real, operating Italian restaurant at 1829 Robson St matching the OSM address and phone. Takeout is confirmed via 'OPEN FOR Dine In, Take Away & Delivery' and an online ordering link; gluten-free pasta is confirmed via '*Gluten free pasta available for most selections.' No mention of bike parking, water refills, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant with a live website, confirmed address, and current menu. Straightforward inclusion as a Food & Drink listing useful to touring cyclists.
